files.README.md:
# Coedwig Firewood - trade order lines, August 2026

One row per order line; packs is the number of packs on the line and pack_prices.csv gives the price of a pack of each product.

turns.prompt: Coedwig Firewood invoices its trade customers by the pack. What was the total value of the packs ordered by Marlpit Nurseries in August 2026? Give the amount as a number of pounds and pence. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
